name: Omarea
author: Thurea
description: Omarea: Thurea family protection made for Omarchy. Protection status, the family's requests and screen time, the verse of the day and one-scan phone setup in the bar, with Omarchy notifications when something needs a parent.

barWidget.description: Thurea in the bar: whether this computer is protected, family requests waiting (a dot on the icon), each child's screen time, the verse of the day and phone setup. Click: open. Middle-click: set up a phone. Keys in the panel: F family, D downloads, P phone, R re-apply, S settings.
